title: The empty language is in polynomial time
statement: The empty language over the binary alphabet, consisting of no finite binary strings, belongs to the class $\mathsf{P}=\bigcup_{c\in\mathbb{N}}\mathrm{DTIME}(n\mapsto n^c+1)$.
replaced: Let $\mathsf{P}$ be the class of languages over $\{0,1\}$ decidable by a deterministic Turing machine in polynomial time. Then the empty language $\emptyset \subseteq \{0,1\}^*$ belongs to $\mathsf{P}$.
